categories.main_business_segments: MEIKO NETWORK JAPAN operates three main business segments: (1) Directly operated individual tutoring schools under the 'Meiko Gijuku' brand, (2) a nationwide franchise business for 'Meiko Gijuku' schools, and (3) Japanese language schools. The company also engages in other education-related businesses, including after-school programs, IT-enabled self-study schools, English immersion preschools, HR solutions, and various career support and welfare services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The core of the company's service delivery is its proprietary individualized instruction method, notably the 'Meiko-style 10-step learning method,' and a franchise system with operational support. The company leverages digital transformation (DX) initiatives, such as ERP systems, data platforms, and custom-developed apps for students and instructors, as well as AI-powered learning tools and digital marketing solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are students from elementary to high school (and their parents) seeking individualized tutoring, as well as franchisees operating Meiko Gijuku schools. The company also serves foreign students at Japanese language schools, working professionals in need of reskilling, HR clients, and children requiring after-school or welfare services.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in Japan, with Meiko Gijuku schools present in all 47 prefectures. The company also has a presence in Taiwan and South Korea through affiliated companies, and has established a subsidiary in Vietnam. Over 90% of revenue is generated from domestic Japanese customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: MEIKO NETWORK JAPAN is positioned downstream in the education and HR services supply chain, directly interfacing with end-users (students, parents, job seekers, and franchisees) and providing both B2C and B2B services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on transitioning from a child-focused education provider to a comprehensive human resource support group serving all life stages. Key initiatives include portfolio diversification, digital transformation (DX), expansion into HR and training businesses, alliances, and investments in new business areas. There is a strong emphasis on innovation, sustainability, diversity, and human capital development, but no traditional R&D activities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through tuition and fees from directly operated schools, franchise royalties and initial fees, sales of educational materials and equipment, Japanese language school tuition, HR placement and dispatch fees, and other service charges. Franchisees pay a royalty based on a percentage of sales, and the company also earns from product sales and consulting to franchisees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Tokyo Individualized Educational Institute, Riso Kyoiku (TOMAS), and SPRIX (Morijuku), among others. MEIKO NETWORK JAPAN is positioned as an industry leader in individualized tutoring with the largest national footprint and a top market share in Japan’s individual tutoring segment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending August 2025, consolidated revenue was 24.8 billion yen (up 10% YoY), with operating profit of 1.69 billion yen (up 67% YoY) and net profit of 1.73 billion yen (up 253% YoY). The company has over 1,200 employees and is targeting continued growth, with a mid-term plan aiming for 26.5 billion yen in sales and 2 billion yen in operating profit by FY2027.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: MEIKO NETWORK JAPAN differentiates itself through its pioneering individualized instruction model, nationwide scale, and robust franchise support system. The company emphasizes hospitality, customized learning experiences, and digital innovation to enhance student outcomes and customer satisfaction. Its transition to a comprehensive human resource support group and commitment to social value creation further strengthen its unique market position.
